notes: Item 19 contains four sets of tables for the 2024 calendar year: (1) All GAC Restaurants (256 units open full 12 months out of 395 total), (2) GAC co-branded with Marble Slab Creamery (120 units out of 160 total), (3) GAC co-branded with Pretzelmaker (19 units out of 26 total), and (4) Standalone GAC only Restaurants (117 units out of 209 total). Each set reports Net Sales (Table 1 with sub-segments by location type, Table 2 as ranges), Food Cost as % of Net Sales (Table 3), and Labor Cost as % of Net Sales (Table 4). The data is unaudited, based on cash-basis accounting, covers only food/paper/labor costs (not a full P&L). Table 2 (Range of Net Sales) records were not individually extracted as separate schema records since they represent distribution bands rather than cohort-level avg/median/min/max statistics — the key statistics are captured in the Table 1 total and sub-segment records. End-Cap and Free Standing rows for Pretzelmaker co-branded set show 0 units and were omitted as they contain no meaningful data.
